author: Fixture Reporter
content: Following Morgan Stanley's decision to reinstate Nvidia Corp. as its top chip pick, institutional inflows surged late Friday, driving trading volume to triple the 30-day moving average. Analyst Joseph Moore issued an expanded note on Friday afternoon revealing that secondary cloud providers have jointly committed an additional $4 billion in infrastructure purchase orders for upcoming architecture rollouts. The updated developments reinforce analyst estimates that revenue per gigawatt will successfully clear the $50 billion threshold ahead of the 2028 target schedule.
headline: Morgan Stanley's Top Pick Status Triggers Massive Institutional Inflows for Nvidia as Secondary Cloud Orders Expand
summary: Institutional buyers rush into Nvidia following Morgan Stanley's top pick designation, backed by new multi-billion dollar cloud purchase orders.
